policies.title: Framework surface changes co-update all referencing distributed artifacts

evidence.summary: User-confirmed operating rule 2026-07-05: when the framework changes, all related skills/prompts/help/parsers must be updated in the same change so downstream updates land consistent.
Record completion CO-CHANGE COMPLETENESS clause lists the artifact classes; precedent defects jcode-prompt rename and init --target= help/parser drift fixed in 5d88a31.

criteria: Co-change checklist proves noisy for changes with no distributed references.

explain.summary: Before closing a framework change, enumerate referencing skills/prompts/extension/help/parser surfaces (grep the changed command/flag/contract name under packages/ and bin/) and update them in the same change.

policies.title: Prefer one primary canonical record per logical work unit

evidence.summary: User selected the guard → sample-cleanup rollout on 2026-07-13 after reviewing Medivance record write amplification.
The synced write/update contract defines one primary narrative record, independent-delta exceptions, and one durable evidence location.
The synced completeness contract defines impact judgement rather than layer mirroring and keeps semantic-delta judgement LLM-owned.
The synced TDD contract protects lossless candidate review without automatic multi-record promotion.

criteria: Dogfood shows the primary-record default hides an independently changed layer.
Agents treat the recommendation as a hard one-file cap instead of an independent-delta test.

explain.summary: Choose one primary canonical narrative record by default. Promote another layer only for an independent semantic delta; otherwise link it or record no independent delta. Consolidate durable repeated validation detail into one evidence capsule.

evidence.summary: Active rulebook compatibility surface defines project operating rule storage and capability binding.
SDD defines lazy rules contract, rulebook entry shape, capability binding, and audit behavior.
TDD protects rulebook list/audit/resolve behavior and sync compatibility.
Policy registry SSOT requires rulebook retire-readiness coverage through typed policy links before changing rulebook semantics.

criteria: Rulebook compatibility surface no longer represents project/team operating policy storage.
Capability-policy link causes noisy or incorrect retire-readiness coverage.

explain.summary: When adding or resolving project/team operating behavior policy, keep human-readable rulebook compatibility surfaces and machine-readable capability bindings linked to typed policy records.

evidence.summary: Existing evidence capsule capability is recommend-level and manual.
Policy changes must use update-loop candidate/canonical transition semantics.

criteria: Evidence capsule recommendation becomes noisy or not useful in dogfood validation.
A stronger level is requested without user/team confirmation.

explain.summary: Before claiming validation is complete, attach or summarize concrete validation evidence from canonical records/tests.

evidence.summary: User confirmed proceeding with the first level=block policy promotion readiness slice on 2026-06-18.
TDD fixture documents allow/block cases and protects block-readiness without lifecycle hook installation.
Guidance Ladder requires hard stops to be narrow, reversible, fixture-protected, and user-confirmed.
Policy Registry SSOT requires block-readiness before lifecycle hard-stop integration.

criteria: The block boundary is too broad or noisy in dogfood use.
The runtime fixture fails to cover both allow and block cases.
A lifecycle integration slice cannot preserve explicit-context and bypass behavior.

runtime.bypass: Bypass requires explicit acknowledgement plus concrete validation evidence or a rollback/demotion decision.

explain.summary: Prepare a narrow block boundary for validation-complete claims made without record/test evidence. This policy is ready for block runtime, but no lifecycle hook is installed in this slice.

policies.title: Warn when validation evidence is missing

evidence.summary: Warn-only runtime requires explicit structured policy context and never blocks.
TDD protects warn-only runtime output, bypass guidance, and no block behavior.

criteria: Warn-only runtime emits noisy warnings for explicit structured policy context.
A warning output suppresses a more important blocking helper in response.completed.

explain.summary: When structured policy context says the agent is making validation claims, warn if concrete validation evidence should be attached or summarized.

runtime.bypass: Continue is allowed; include a short reason when bypassing the warning.
